en.title: Beef & Cheese Flatbread
en.tagline: Soft pan-fried flatbread with beef and cheese, cut into strips for self-feeding.
en.intro: A handheld flatbread for Xyla at about 1 year old. This is a version actually made on November 20, 2026.

sections.title: Dough (about 1 piece)
items: 100 g flour
3 g sugar
2 g instant yeast, mixed straight into the flour (no need to bloom first)
80 g water
sections.text: Stir into a dough or a slightly soft batter. Cover with plastic wrap. Place it in the microwave with a bowl of hot water beside it; do not turn the microwave on. Let it proof for about 30 minutes, until the dough has puffed up.

sections.title: Method
steps: Add cooked ground beef, or seasoned ground beef that will be fully cooked.
Roll it up, then flatten again.
Optionally brush the pan with a thin layer of oil, add a little water, cover, and pan-fry over low heat until soft and cooked through.

sections.title: Baby tips
items: No added salt in the dough.
Choose a lower-sodium cheese, such as mozzarella or Swiss.
The beef must be fully cooked.
Let it cool, then cut into strips so a 1-year-old can self-feed.
Beef is a good source of iron.

sections.title: Optional proofing note
sections.text: The original inspiration dough ratio was 400 g flour : 330 g water : 4 g yeast : 5 g sugar. Proof at 28–35°C until about doubled; do not exceed 40°C.

zh.title: 宝宝牛肉芝士饼
zh.tagline: 软软的牛肉芝士饼，切成条，方便自己抓着吃。
zh.intro: 给大约 1 岁的宝宝自己抓着吃。这是 2026 年 11 月 20 日实际做过的一版。

sections.title: 面皮（约 1 张）
items: 面粉 100 克
糖 3 克
即发干酵母（instant yeast） 2 克，直接和面粉拌匀，不用先泡
水 80 克
sections.text: 搅匀成面团或稍软的面糊，盖上保鲜膜。把面放到微波炉里，旁边放一碗热水，微波炉本身不要开，发酵约 30 分钟，等面胀起来即可。

sections.title: 做法
steps: 放上熟牛肉馅，或事先调好、会完全炒熟的牛肉末。
锅里可以刷一层薄油，再加一点点水，盖上盖子，小火煎到软熟。

sections.title: 给宝宝吃的小提示
items: 面里不要额外加盐。
芝士选钠比较低的，比如马苏里拉或瑞士芝士。
牛肉一定要完全熟透。
晾温后切成条，方便大约 1 岁的宝宝自己抓着吃。
牛肉是铁的好来源。

sections.title: 发面参考（可选）
sections.text: 最初参考的面糊比例是：面粉 400 克、水 330 克、酵母 4 克、糖 5 克。发面温度大约 28–35°C，等到大约两倍大即可，不要超过 40°C。

en.title: Bread Flour Toast
en.tagline: A light, low-sugar, no-salt loaf from the bread machine, for Xyla at about 1 year old.
en.intro: Made in a Panasonic SD-MT4 bread machine, program 3「食パン」(shokupan), crust color「淡」(light). This is a home adjustment of a half-sugar, no-salt version, not an official Panasonic recipe. One loaf from a 250 g flour batch in the SD-MT4.

sections.title: Ingredients
items: King Arthur Bread Flour 250 g (weigh on a scale)
Cold milk 70 g
Cold water 125 g
Unsalted butter 15 g
Sugar 8.5 g
Salt: optional; left out in this version
Instant dry yeast 2.8 g, in the yeast dispenser (must be instant yeast, not active dry)

sections.title: Method
steps: Put the paddle in. Add flour, sugar, and butter to the pan in that order, then pour in the milk and water.
Lock the pan back into the machine. Put the yeast in the top dispenser.
Choose program 3, crust「淡」(light), and press start. It takes about 4 hours. The machine does the mixing, proofing, and baking; there are no separate times or temperatures.
After it finishes, wait about 2 minutes, then turn the loaf out onto a rack. Cool 1–2 hours until it is not hot, then seal it in a bag. Freeze sliced leftovers.

sections.title: Water adjustments
items: At a room temperature of about 25°C, use 115 g water.
If the top collapses or the inside is sticky, use 120 g water.
If it is still dry, use up to 130 g water.

sections.title: Baby tips
items: Low sugar, and no added salt.
Allergens: wheat and milk (plus butter).
Cool completely, then seal in a bag. Freeze sliced leftovers.

sections.title: Optional note
sections.text: The first version used all-purpose flour (110 g water, 10 g butter) and came out a bit dry, so it became bread flour with 125 g water and 15 g butter.

zh.title: 高筋面粉版吐司
zh.tagline: 面包机做的淡味吐司，低糖不加盐，给大约 1 岁的宝宝吃。
zh.intro: 用松下 SD-MT4 面包机，选程序 3「食パン」（日式吐司），表皮颜色选「淡」。这是自己改过的半糖、不加盐版本，不是松下官方配方。一次出一条（250 克面粉用量，用 SD-MT4）。

sections.title: 用料
items: King Arthur 高筋面粉 250 克（请用秤称）
冷牛奶 70 克
冷水 125 克
无盐黄油 15 克
糖 8.5 克
盐：可选，这版不加
即发干酵母 2.8 克，放进酵母投放盒（必须是 instant yeast，不要用需要先活化的 active dry yeast）

sections.title: 做法
steps: 先装好搅拌桨。按面粉、糖、黄油的顺序放进桶里，再倒入牛奶和水。
把桶锁回机器，酵母放进顶部的投放盒。
选程序 3，表皮选「淡」，按开始。大约 4 小时做完。搅拌、发酵、烘烤都由机器完成，没有另外的时间和温度。
结束后大约等 2 分钟，把面包倒出来放到晾网上。晾 1–2 小时，等不烫了再装进袋子密封。切好剩下的可以冷冻。

sections.title: 水量怎么调
items: 室温大约 25°C 时，水改用 115 克。
如果顶部塌了，或里面发黏，用水 120 克。
如果还是偏干，水最多可以加到 130 克。

sections.title: 给宝宝吃的小提示
items: 低糖，没有额外加盐。
含小麦和牛奶过敏原（还有黄油）。
完全晾凉后再装袋密封；切好剩下的可以冷冻。

sections.title: 可选备注
sections.text: 第一版用的是中筋面粉（水 110 克、黄油 10 克），做出来有点干，所以改成了高筋面粉，水 125 克、黄油 15 克。
